title: UI and visual design (house style, tokens, themes, generated artifacts)

questions.text: Which existing screen is the visual reference, and which kit components will I reuse? If there is no agreed image of good, render 2-3 options first.
Is this a restyle (no new elements) or a redesign (new elements)? Write the one-line scope.
Which tokens cover every colour, radius, spacing and font I need; which are missing and go into the token file first?
Which states and themes exist: default, empty, loading, error, 404, permission-denied x light/dark x desktop/mobile?
Which brand surfaces could this touch (logo, mascot, sign-in), and are they under screenshot baselines?
For generated artifacts (documents, images, chat answers): what is the template, and what do the first line and first page look like?
Is every new component or screen registered where the project keeps its component gallery or catalogue, so the next restyle reaches it?
Which prompt or design restrictions come from the owner's words, and which did I invent?
What density applies (compact for data tables; width follows content)?
Pre-mortem: it shipped and got reverted. What was the reason?

budgets.measure: axe color-contrast in light and dark, including opened modals
token pair ratio for borders, icons, focus rings

rules.title: Colour literal outside the token files
rules.why: Bypasses the tokens, so it breaks in the other theme and drifts from the brand.
rules.confirm: static-proof plus render: the element in dark mode fails contrast or differs from the token value
rules.fixHint: use or add a token; never a literal in a feature file

rules.title: Raw <button>/<input>/<dialog> or third-party primitive in a feature file when the kit has one
rules.why: Screens built from raw primitives look and behave unlike the rest of the app.
rules.confirm: render: side-by-side screenshot with the reference screen

rules.title: New sections, heroes, decorative cards or filler text in a restyle
rules.why: Nobody asked for them; the owner reverts them.
rules.confirm: render: aria/heading outline diff vs base shows new landmarks

rules.title: Surface checked in one theme only; portal rendered outside the theme root
rules.why: Invisible buttons and wrong-theme modals in the other theme.
rules.confirm: render: axe color-contrast per emulated colorScheme with each modal open

rules.title: Generated document opens with a chat preface or carries Markdown residue
rules.why: The document reads like a chat reply, not a document.
rules.confirm: static-proof on extracted text: first paragraph matches a preface pattern

rules.title: Screenshot older than the last source change or without a commit stamp
rules.why: The image shows code that is no longer there.
rules.confirm: static-proof: screenshot mtime < newest changed source file

rules.title: Raw utility palette class (bg-black/55, text-green-500) instead of a token class
rules.why: A palette colour is a literal with another name: it ignores the theme and drifts from the tokens.
rules.confirm: static-proof plus render: the class is on an added line; in the other theme the element fails contrast or differs from the token value
rules.fixHint: map it to a semantic token class (bg-surface, text-danger)
knownFalsePositives: projects whose tokens are the raw palette by design (turn the rule off in .jstack/unslop.json)

rules.title: New shared component with no entry in the component gallery or stories
rules.why: A component nobody can see in the gallery is missed by the next restyle and audit.
rules.confirm: static-proof: the component name has no reference under the gallery or stories folder at HEAD

rules.title: New 'never / only / always' constraint in a generation prompt or design spec with no source in the request
rules.why: Self-invented limits narrow every output (one colour, one body type, refused styles) and nobody asked for them.
rules.confirm: repro-script: quote the request next to each new constraint (empty source cell), then generate 10 samples with and without it and show the narrowed spread

verify.text: token lint over every styling surface: no new colour literals on added lines
built app: screen inventory x {light, dark} x {desktop, 390 px mobile}
axe color-contrast per theme with modals and menus open: 0 violations
restyle: aria/heading outline unchanged vs base
toHaveScreenshot on brand surfaces in both themes; brand asset hashes match the manifest; img naturalWidth > 0
before/after contact sheet stamped with HEAD, opened for the reviewer
